name: message-times
description: Puts the time on each prompt and each reply in Claude Code's main transcript view, and keeps the times across a resume.

dir.title: Notes folder
dir.description: Folder for the notes files, one per session (stamps-<session id>.tsv). A relative path is under the project the session runs in; give an absolute path to keep every project's times in one place.

locale.title: Day separator language
locale.description: BCP 47 locale the day separators are written in (es-ES, en-GB…). Empty uses the runtime's default.
